## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that adding a time-of-day gate to the V14E bear setup will improve the edge capture by filtering out trades during less favorable hours.

## Mechanism

The proposed mechanism involves adding a time-of-day gate to the V14E bear setup, where the engine only considers trades during the 10:00-11:00 ET time window. This gate is designed to filter out trades during less favorable hours and improve the overall edge capture.
